root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: the current-insert copy/skip path must require `buffer->idx < buffer->len` in addition to `!before` before it may operate on a current glyph
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When the end-of-text insertion entry is reached, the current-insert branch may only copy or skip a current glyph if `buffer->idx < buffer->len && !before` holds. The vulnerable original checks only `!before`, so the end-of-text path still executes `copy_glyph()` and `skip_glyph()` on `info[len]`. The fixed source restores the missing `buffer->idx < buffer->len` conjunct at this exact root-cause line.
root_cause_criterion.description: MemorySanitizer's origin stack points back to the end-of-text current-insert copy in `AAT::InsertionSubtable::driver_context_t::transition`. The missing source-level obligation is the live-current-glyph guard `buffer->idx < buffer->len && !before` before the current-insert path may read or skip a glyph.

nodes.state: At the `glyph >= num_metrics` sink, the `glyph` parameter still has fewer initialized bytes than its full `sizeof(glyph)` width, so the branch consumes an uninitialized codepoint.
At the faulting current-insert copy, `idx == len`, so `out_info[out_len] = info[idx]` reads the logical one-past-end slot `info[len]`.

edges.relation: The copied pseudo-glyph stays at the same logical output slot: `copy_glyph()` writes it at slot `out_len`, and after `move_to(end + count)` the surviving copied record is still the slot named by `end`.

After `swap_buffers()` publishes the output span, the preserved copied pseudo-glyph reappears as loop index `i` when `hb_ot_get_glyph_h_advances` iterates over the live glyph buffer and reads `info[i].codepoint`.
